note: Second screening on medium land maps, played to the end (day limit 300): eight switches or groups of switches on the base {"magicWorth": 1} (d9280, 384 games: magicWorth 1 +0.07 +- 0.10, the only switch that leans to the good side; passage + regionValue -0.12 +- 0.08 and noChase 1 -0.10 +- 0.10 cost games; townHeroes + secondArmy + nightWatch, townWorth + townAmbush, breakout 2: nothing). 2^(8-4) resolution IV, 24 games per configuration, shared pool. K = breakout 4 + supplyRuns 2: the expedition - from the third week on the leader looks for the next town while none is among its targets, and its troops are brought to it (probe games to day 45 on sixteen seats: 3.2 towns against 2.5 with the standard, 52 % of the map seen against 39 %; breakout 4 without supply: 2.6 towns and a leader's army a third smaller). S = supplyRuns 2 alone (in configurations with K it changes nothing: read it as three arms - neither 96 games, S alone 96, K 192). V = threatRadius 24 instead of 16: in the first 116 games of d9282, of 202 attacks on armies of ours of 20,000 or more in the open field, 67 came from an enemy our reach model had 16 to 20 tiles away the evening before and 13 from 20 to 24 (18 from 12 to 16) - a hero covers 15 to 20 tiles a day without any bonus, and ours keep 16 away. B = boldBehind 1; E = heroEdge 1.15 (our attacks at a model ratio of 1.3 to 1.6 won 97 % at a loss of 30 %, at 1.15 to 1.3 six of seven); Q = campaignEdge 2.0; G = townHeroes 1 + secondArmy 1 + nightWatch 1 + gather 2; M = magicWorth 2. (heroTolerance 0.85 was dropped: of 192 attacks on us only two came at a model ratio of 0.85 to 1.0.) breakout 3 is measured in the fresh-map ladder d9282.
